propositions: The test monkeypatch stub observed_upsert has a narrow signature that does not accept the keyword-only parameters evidence_sufficient and seeded that the real CriterionBank.upsert now accepts.

Production code correctly passes evidence_sufficient=False via the bounded-fallback path (record_insufficient) and seeded=True via the cache seed path, causing TypeError when the monkeypatch intercepts these calls.

The bedrock LLM arm triggers the bounded-fallback path (insufficient evidence) where evidence_sufficient is passed, while anthropic/openai arms gather sufficient evidence and never hit the fallback, making the failure bedrock-specific and deterministic.

The fix threads all keyword arguments through the test stub via **kwargs, extracting the wrapper into a shared helper tests/_bank_observer.py::make_observed_upsert that forwards evidence_sufficient, seeded, and future kwargs unchanged to the real upsert.

After the fix, the TypeError is eliminated and test_dense_completion_banks_and_terminates_in_two_of_three_trials produces verdicts on all trials (error=None, verdict=PASS) without production code changes.
